reviews.text: not going to lie, the texture is very strange in the pot. almost like a putty consistency?? I’m not sure how to do even describe it. that said, it melts into your skin really nicely and also isn’t greasy. it is thick but it does absorb welll. i use this in the evenings after I remove my makeup when I get home to hydrate my face. i really like it! i also use it for my hands
reviews.zh: 老實講，佢喺罐入面嘅質地好奇怪，好似膩子膏咁??我真係唔知點形容好。不過佢貼落皮膚好容易化開，又唔油膩。質地厚，但吸收得好好。我返到屋企卸妝之後嘅夜晚用嚟補濕面部。我好鍾意！我仲用嚟護手。

reviews.text: I just love this cream so much, it beats many really high end creams I've used such as the likes of SK-II! It has a jelly like texture in the tub, but once applied on skin, it just melts away. It is super hydrating but light weight, I can lather up a thick layer like a mask and never breakout from it and I have combination skin so can be oily in the T-zones. Really suitable for night but I can use it during winter days too. My face always feels silky smooth in the morning after using this at night, am so impressed I keep telling my family and friends to try.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款面霜，佢勝過我用過嘅好多高端面霜，例如 SK-II 呢啲！罐入面係果凍狀質地，但係一塗到皮膚上就即刻化開。佢補水力好強，但質地輕盈，我可以好似面膜咁厚厚噉塗一層，都從來唔會因此爆痘。我係混合皮膚，T 字位會出油。好啱晚上用，但冬天日間用都得。我晚上用完呢款，早上起身個面都係滑嘅，我真係好欣賞，所以一直叫屋企人同朋友試吓。

reviews.text: I really have been enjoying this cream. The texture is crazy thick - almost solid, but when you massage it into the skin it sinks in fairly quickly. I was worried with it being as thick as it is that it would be greasy, but it does not leave an unpleasant greasy or tacky residue, but a light, silky finish.
reviews.zh: 我真係好享受呢款面霜。質地極之厚，差唔多係固體咁，但係按入皮膚之後會吸收得幾快。我本來擔心咁厚會油膩，但係佢唔會留低令人不舒服嘅油膩或黏膩感，而係輕盈、絲滑嘅效果。

reviews.text: THIS cream is THICK. I mean it, but I just love it as someone with very dry skin. You have to work it in your hands to melt it and then you apply. This cream is strongly fragranced so sensitive skin be mindful of this but as for performance, I feel as though it started off pretty intense and moist but after some time it settled in the skin and it wasn't really sticky or tacky at all. The moisture I found not long lasting (4 hours or so), I had high hopes for this. Overall, it's a pretty nice thick af cream that isn't tacky or sticky and felt nice, even on my hands but that moisture doesn't last long enough for me. 4/5
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜真係好厚，我係認真嘅。但我好鍾意，因為我嘅皮膚好乾。要喺手裏搓暖佢先至化開，然後先塗。呢款面霜香味好濃，敏感皮膚要留意。至於效果，我覺得首先好濃、好水潤，過咗一陣子就滲入皮膚，完全唔黏亦唔膩。不過我覺得保濕力唔夠耐（大約四個鐘）。我本來好期望呢款。整體嚟講係一款幾好、超厚嘅面霜，唔黏唔膩，塗落好舒服，即使塗喺手上都好好，不過保濕效果對我嚟講唔夠耐。4/5

reviews.text: I was looking for something to soothe my dry, peeling and sometimes irritated skin as I use tretinoin at night time and LET ME TELL YOU!!! This is so soothing. My skin can be absolutely burning and as soon as I use this is calms and cools my skin and keeps it moisturizer ALL DAY without feeling heavy and greasy. The cream is thick but as soon as you scoop it up you can feel how light and airy it is. Because the saturated oils are so similar to ones found in our own bodies my skin responds amazingly to it. I will use this as a moisturizer and to sooth minor skin irritation for LIFE!!!
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵啲嘢舒緩我嘅乾燥、脫皮，有時仲會刺激嘅皮膚，因為我晚上用緊維A酸，所以我話畀你知！！！呢款好舒緩。我嘅皮膚有時會好似燒咁痛，但係一用呢款就即刻令皮膚平靜、降溫，成日都保持水潤，唔會覺得厚重油膩。面霜質地厚，但一挖起嚟就感覺到好輕盈、好鬆化。因為佢嘅飽和油脂同我哋身體嘅油脂好相似，所以我嘅皮膚對佢反應好好。我會將佢當保濕霜用，亦會用嚟舒緩輕微嘅皮膚刺激，用一世啦！！！

reviews.text: I have purchased this product for my mother as a present. She loves it. The texture is very thick and velvety. The cream smells very nice. It comes with a cute small spatula, but I reccomend to take some of it with hands and to warm it up a little. This way the cream spreds easily on the face. My mom use it as a night cream. I have also tred it and I will by one for myself too!
reviews.zh: 我買呢款產品做禮物送畀我媽媽。佢好鍾意。質地好厚、好絲絨感。面霜聞落好香。附有一支好可愛嘅細刮刀，不過我建議用手挖少少，搓暖一下，咁樣面霜就容易塗開喺面上。我媽媽用佢做晚霜。我都試過，我都會自己買一罐！

reviews.text: I bought this product purely for the milk bottle shaped container. Unfortunately they changed the packaging and that is not the container I received.I was quite saddened as that is exactly why I bought the product. I've been using it for about a month now and I have to say I don't regret this purchase. I have very finicky skin, it will be extremely oily and extremely dry at the same time. I typically don't use moisturizer is unless I absolutely have to for this reason. I've been able to use this cream on my face even on my oily areas and it seems to help reduce the oiliness and shine for me.usually if I put a moisturizer on my face at night I have to wash my face in the morning as it will be so oily you could fry an egg on my face but I've noticed when I wake up in the morning after using this lotion my skin is still Matte and I'm ready to go one less step in the morning.
reviews.zh: 我純粹因為佢似牛奶樽嘅樽形包裝先買呢款產品。可惜佢哋轉咗包裝，我收到嘅唔係嗰個樽。我好失望，因為呢個正正係我買嘅原因。我用咗大約一個月，我必須話我唔後悔呢次購買。我嘅皮膚好難伺候，會同時好油又好乾。我通常唔會用保濕霜，除非真係迫不得已，就係因為咁。我可以喺面上（包括油位）用呢款乳霜，佢似乎幫我減少咗出油同油光。通常我晚上塗保濕霜，早上就要洗面，因為面會油到可以煎蛋咁；但係我發現用咗呢款乳液之後，早上起身皮膚仍然係啞光嘅，早上少咗一個步驟就可以即刻出門。

reviews.text: This cream is really nice, it smells really good and comes in a super cute jar. It has a really smooth consistency and rubs in with a matt finish. I have really dry skin and it makes it feel very moisurized. The only thing is that sometimes a couple hours after putting it on my face can feel a little oily.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜真係好好，聞落好香，仲有個超級可愛嘅樽。質地好順滑，推開之後係啞光效果。我嘅皮膚好乾，用完感覺好滋潤。唯一嘅問題係有時塗咗幾個鐘之後，面會有啲油。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
